content.introduction: Uber plans a $2.3 billion acquisition of ezCater to expand into catering, offering large order delivery for business events. The retail giant has struck a deal with Warner Bros. Discovery so advertisers can target Walmart shoppers on linear TV. Zeroset has come out of stealth and raised $5.2 million to build models that give AI agents a constantly updated picture of a company's operations. The EV fast-charging company has doubled its number of stations this year. Its CEO tells Business Insider it will roll out new dealer EV training. From the front lines of Ukraine to the remote Pacific, the world is increasingly reliant on Starlink. The company says it rivals some of China's leading open models while using far less computing power. Elon Musk is once again a trillionaire, a title he initially held in June after SpaceX's blockbuster IPO. Leif Abraham, Public's co-CEO, told Business Insider he wants vintage wines and fancy Levi's jeans. Meta's Muse AI agent buys them for him.
